rationale: In v1 the edge set of every template is frozen: an edge carries a semantic payload class and a provenance/rule ref, and rewiring could silently invalidate either. Two graphs of the same template therefore share a structural signature and are topological near-duplicates. A leakage-free split can only put a template lineage on one side of the boundary, so the split is a FAMILY holdout by template lineage, exactly the 'held-out application families' generalisation axis declared in the dataset card. Regime factors (workload/resource/SLA) and parent-seed sibling groups are used to stratify support/query and to check leakage, never to spread one lineage across roles.

support_query.allocation: proportional largest-remainder over strata, ascending stratum-id tie-break
support_query.disjointness: support and query are disjoint by construction and re-checked by the leakage checker

calibration.note: every calibration/normalisation statistic must be computed from meta-train graphs only

meta_test_isolation.note: meta-test stays unopened until the model-side freeze; this dataset milestone only assigns the role
